clips.title: The story
paras: The Goddess Provides is an introductory kaldorei quest centered on recognizing Elune's divine gifts. Set in the boughs of Teldrassil following the end of the Long Vigil, it teaches young night elves to embrace the lunar guidance and cloaking shadows bestowed by Mother Moon.

For millennia following the Sundering, the kaldorei maintained their solitary Long Vigil, watching over Kalimdor and guarding the sacred peaks of Mount Hyjal. The devastation of the Third War and the climactic defense of the World Tree forced an end to that ancient seclusion. Now relocated to the sheltering boughs of Teldrassil, the night elves face an unfamiliar world, stepping onto the broader stage of Azeroth by aligning themselves with distant allies across the ocean.

Even amidst shifting allegiances and new dwellings, the foundation of kaldorei identity remains rooted in the worship of Elune, the Mother Moon. Night elves are taught from their earliest days to call upon her dual aspects: radiance to guide martial strikes and clarify purpose, and shadow to cloak one's presence from enemy sight. Calling upon these hereditary gifts serves as both spiritual communion and practical preparation for the perils beyond the Great Tree.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and shall become a great priestess of our goddess Elune. Her grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.
Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.
Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.
